description: A corrected GRU4Rec cold start for sequential recommendation on four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent GRU-based model per category and select configurations using macro-average validation HR@10. The supplied content defines an experimental protocol rather than a new paper or a fully specified architecture.
motivation: Establish a reproducible GRU4Rec baseline and support improvements within the same model family under fixed data splits, evaluation rules, and compute budget.
implementation_notes: Use preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch. Read data from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and save artifacts beneath the trial directory. Preserve left padding and read the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep category routing, checkpoint architecture, and the embedded predictor writer consistent. Each category must load exactly one trained model; independent predictor fusion is prohibited. Retain the family-specific ModelView interfaces and DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning measured metrics and metric_definitions, plus diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). The host evaluates 200 validation users per category with 99 unique negatives and evaluation seed 42. No baseline source, detailed architecture, or measured results were supplied.
pseudocode:
Set preprocessing seed to 0 and training seed to 42.
For each of the four categories:
    Load the supplied fixed splits from GAGC_DATA_DIR.
    Initialize the corrected GRU4Rec-family model.
    Train for at most 200 epochs, using 200 batches per epoch.
    Encode left-padded histories and read their final nonpadding position.
    Save one selected model checkpoint beneath the trial directory.
Generate working/predict.py with matching architecture and category routing.
Let the host compute category validation HR@10 and its macro average.
Use only permitted validation evidence to guide subsequent trials.

originality.positive: Provides explicit corrections and consistency requirements for a controlled GRU4Rec comparison.
originality.negative: On a 1–10 scale, methodological novelty is low: no new architecture, objective, or empirical finding is described.

future_potential.positive: The fixed protocol supports controlled experiments with jointly trained GRU layers, losses, sampling strategies, and optimization.
future_potential.negative: Potential gains remain unmeasured and must fit the shared 43,200 GPU-second search budget.

code_difficulty.positive: Per-category GRU training and routing are straightforward with a supplied working baseline.
code_difficulty.negative: Moderate difficulty comes from preserving padding semantics, diagnostic compatibility, reproducibility, and checkpoint–predictor consistency; the baseline code was not included.
